articles.title_en: Ukraine’s ‘Operation Vivaldi’ pushed Russian forces back around Lyman in the Donbas. Now both armies are massing troops for the next battles farther south.
articles.lead_en: Andriy Biletsky, commander of Ukraine’s 3rd Army Corps, said this week that his units are successfully carrying out Operation “Vivaldi.” The first of its four phases, he said, is nearing completion: Russian units near the town of Lyman, which had been trying to push through to the Siverskyi Donets River opposite Sloviansk, have been driven back across the Chornyi Zherebets River, a tributary of the Siverskyi Donets. Judging by published footage, the situation for Russian forces has indeed deteriorated as a result of a Ukrainian offensive that has lasted several months.
